claims.claim: Semaglutide effectively reduces the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in patients with type 2 diabetes.

citations.quote: According to international guidelines, GLP-1RAs are recommended for patients with type 2 diabetes who have established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease or are considered at high cardiovascular risk. Semaglutide, a GLP-1RA, has been linked to reduced rates of MACE, including heart attacks and strokes, in patients with diabetes [31, 32].

claims.quote: According to international guidelines, GLP-1RAs are recommended for patients with type 2 diabetes who have established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease or are considered at high cardiovascular risk. claims.claim: In SUSTAIN-6, semaglutide reduced MACE by 26% compared with placebo (HR 0.74, 95% CI 0.58–0.95).

citations.quote: In SUSTAIN-6, wherein semaglutide (subcutaneous injection) was administered at 0.5 or 1 mg per week, MACE was also reduced by 26% in the semaglutide group compared with the placebo group (HR 0.74, 95% CI 0.58–0.95) as was stroke (HR 0.61, 95% CI 0.38–0.99) [17].
